title: Mercy and Judgment: the flood (Genesis 6:17) and the covenant (Genesis 6:18)
summary: Genesis 6:17 (the flood to destroy all flesh) and Genesis 6:18 (God establishes His covenant and Noah's family enters the ark), separated by the line '↓ Mercy ↓ God ↑ Judgment ↑' with God written in blue, red and yellow letters.

text.text: 17 “Behold, I, even I am bringing the flood of water upon the earth, to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life, from under heaven; everything that is on the earth shall perish.
18 “But I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall enter the ark — you and your sons and your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

keywords: you and your sons and your wife
